answers.core:
This will most likely involve adding built-in mechanics and changing core GDScript. It is somewhat a combination of keywords 'onready', 'export', and possibly 'tool'.
Even more it will realistically be touching almost every scene in most projects and I believe that goes well beyond the scope of most add-ons.
answers.workaround:
I believe it will be used very often by most developers. 
Furthermore I believe that even though it can be 'worked around' with some extra scripting it will make accessing properties much safer, much less error-prone, and much more compact and readable.
